derived_preview_rtl.change: Accept the full interval from actual VS boundary through the back porch, closing at the first HREF. Requests in later horizontal blanks still wait for the next complete frame; original boundary timestamp, CRC, full frame checks and DMA are retained.
derived_preview_rtl.rough_resource_delta: Against deployed0x339f2a4f: one pixel-domain blank-open bit per camera and small control logic; no new DSP, BRAM, DMA engine or arithmetic array. New actual physical review required.

derived_rtl.proof: For cancel=0 both legacy cancel expressions are0; for cancel=1 selected_context=owner_context. Also context_start requires take&&selected_context, hence context_ready, idle and !context_busy; CHECK_BUSY_START=0 removes only that impossible child fault term. Context cancelled is masked only during acknowledged clear. DMA selection now uses registered owner_context. The preselection differs only with both children idle/quiet, no clear/cancel/fault and an offered command. Neither child has any DMA command/data/return strobe then, checked by an integration assertion; its earliest new request follows the same edge that updates owner_context. A drained legacy FAILED state may retain a cancel bit, but fabric per-client quiet implies no pending/live payload (rejected/early_cancel or launched backend idle); cancellation cannot affect a different owner. Request write/read types and aperture are identical, so inactive ready probes remain valid. Descriptor readiness still uses selected_context. No owner switch during active traffic, no new registers or normal cycles; all drain semantics retained.

derived_box_rtl.change: Only insert the existing two-slot65bit ready FIFO after the original shared BOX kernel. Preserve payload/last order and every arithmetic source. Include FIFO occupancy in busy/quiescent; command start/cancel flush metadata; actual DMA drain remains unchanged.
derived_box_rtl.latency: One registered transfer stage, one output per cycle when unstalled; at most one admission bubble after a full stall. Full job cycles and actual timing must be measured.

derived_context_rtl.specialization: CHECK_BUSY_START=0 only in the exact verified INTEGER parent. context_start implies context_ready, idle and !context_busy. Preserve standalone default1. Capture the accepted prior beat in existing read_word; quantize lowFP32 then highFP32 through one shared nearest-even symmetric32767 quantizer, retaining low16 in consumed read_word bits. For exponent115..130,shift=139-exponent is9..24:scaled={mantissa,24zeros}>>shift has q=scaled[39:24],guard=scaled[23],sticky=OR(scaled[22:0]); these exactly encode the original quotient/remainder/half test. Suppress increment at q32767. Signed output is(q XOR signmask)+(sign XOR increment), equal to q+increment or -q-increment modulo16bits. Outside that exponent range preserve original zero/clamp. NaN is rejected before conversion. Preserve packing/order/addresses and all offered DMA handshakes; both local states honor stop before further output.

derived_sgm_rtl.fault_edge_difference: Pool may consume/discard one offered input on an accumulator-overflow edge. Existing priority still suppresses all commits and reports93 on that same edge; FAILED suppresses subsequent traffic. Parent fault handling drains and quarantines the frame. No complete result is accepted from that attempt.
derived_sgm_rtl.bound: For each anchor a pixel contributes triangular weights totalling at most16, cost at most192;16 pixels give mass<=256 and numerator<=49152. Tag/lane validation and first-pixel initialization remain. Invalid metadata/cost, timeout, cancel and overflow detection remain.
derived_sgm_rtl.dma_invariant: All nonzero fault assignments enter DRAIN; FAILED preserves fault; quiet CLEAR changes FAILED to IDLE while clearing fault. RUN completion cannot override a read-state1/3/4 failure because completion requires read_state5. Default invalid state also enters DRAIN. Assertion is simulation-only.

derived_sgm_role.change:
Specialize only the SGM fabric's already fixed read0/write1 client roles.

With CLIENTS=2, producer reader.cmd_write is tied0 and writer.cmd_write tied1.
Each side therefore has at most one eligible client. Keeping its payload
selected even while valid=0 removes the valid->selection->range-add path.
Acceptance, permit, client bounds, cancel/drain, poison and backend are unchanged.
Default parameters retain the complete original arbiter for all other users.

sgm_role_local.scope: Every-cycle full responses and valid AXI control/payload equality to original generic fabric under independent same DDR fixtures. Fixed producer types, changing request/permit,4KiB splits, backpressure, range faults, cancellation and resets. Stress inputs need not obey the SGM producer schedule; complete frame replay separately checks production use. Backend arithmetic/protocol unchanged.

derived_window_rtl.change: Remove only unreachable active address_bad -> fault/active/packet_valid feedback; retain all descriptor extent/scalar admission, address/payload/counter logic and an executable simulation invariant.
derived_window_rtl.invariant:
Exact removal of an unreachable address-fault feedback cone.

For an admitted normal command, 1<=width<=pitch, 1<=kw,kh<=4 and
1<=channels*kw*kh<=768. The nested counters advance only on calc_take and
stop at the last term, so ky<kh and channel<channels. For any selected valid
row, admission already proved offset+channels*pitch<=16384. Thus
offset+channel*pitch+clamp <= offset+channels*pitch-1 < 16384. The same
bound prevents the 14-bit channel_offset from wrapping on such commands.
If no selected row is valid, every normal calc_mask is zero.

DW admission requires kh=3 and offset+pitch<=4096 for every valid row;
channel_offset never advances, and 0<=clamp<width<=pitch. Consequently its
masked address is <4096. This also holds for the existing pair/pixels=1
zero-term corner case (which is cancelled by the local test, not repaired).
Reset/cancel clear active; preparation checks finish before active; commands
cannot replace live counters. Stalls/clear do not invalidate these invariants.
No counter upset or forced internal corruption is part of this equivalence.

window_local.scope: Every-cycle interface/state equality to original RTL; legal/malformed extent boundaries, masks, coordinates, stalls, live-command rejection, preparation/active cancellation and clear/retry. Runtime address and counter invariants checked in reachable states. No injected internal counter corruption; no full-network or physical pass.

derived_packet_rtl.change:
Normalize writer tags before the existing FIFO, without adding storage.

The FIFO preserves order and metadata. Moving the pure packet transform to
its input is cycle equivalent for valid outputs because co is command-owned
and cannot change until the FIFO is empty (or reset/cancel discards it).
The 16-bit wrapping addition and last predicate are copied exactly. Invalid
payload bits are not part of the ready/valid contract; in_valid remains zero.

packet_local.scope: Actual original/derived parent FIFO boundary forced with identical post-stage inputs, held output, malformed/overflowing tags, all row bits, channel counts1..16 and cancel/reset. Compares valid writer payload and every-cycle FIFO controls. This isolated boundary fixture does not replace full production reachability, arithmetic, cancel/drain or physical checks.

derived_context_cursor.invariant: For every reachable loaded<1280, loaded=640*right+320*group+80*lane+x, x in0..79. Reset/cancel/idle-clear/admitted-start reset both representations. Only an ordered accepted load increments both; x79 carries into lane, lane3 into group, group1 into right. At loaded1280 load_ready is false, so wrapped cursor is unobservable to writes/admission. Retain the original loaded counter, capacity/start tests, malformed-load fault, raw reset/cancel/clear write behavior, all arithmetic, output control and cycle schedule.

context_cursor_local.scope: Both complete actual context-row cores, original renamed only. Every-cycle external control/output and memory-write admission comparison, linear-count/cursor invariant, five complete nonzero/random rows with output stalls,72 malformed-tag/early-start cases at12 carry boundaries, all18 busy-state cancellations, four reset/cancel/clear/start load collisions and retry. Does not replace full-system numerical or physical checks.

conclusion: Component applicability only:26 selected legacy files match the original132-layer/3-output RTL run. The context-row load-order subtract chain is replaced by an11bit registered cursor; original count/admission/error and all compute cycles stay unchanged, verified against the actual original core including full rows and cancellation. Writer tags are normalized before the existing109bit FIFO with no added cycles/storage, checked at both actual parent boundaries; complete production behavior is a separate full replay. The window derivative removes only an unreachable live address fault after complete extent admission; every-cycle original RTL and reachable-state invariants are checked separately. Exact reviewed derivations route DMA by the registered owner across proven inactive admission boundaries and simplify owner-cancel, specialize an impossible busy-context restart under the parent admission invariant, acknowledge cancellation during clear, add the two-slot65bit BOX output FIFO, and share a numerically equivalent guard/sticky nearest-even prior quantizer across two local steps using existing read_word storage. Fresh interface tests cover INTEGER cancellation/retry, busy context restart rejection/drain/clean-clear, BOX heldW/B cancellation/4860 nonzero-prefix outputs, and local seeded prior-phase1024 values/256 packed words, both conversion-stage cancellations and NaN rejection. Complete-row reachability/numerical proof remains a separate full-frame run. Quantization semantics and8SGM/DMA files stay frozen. The SGM fabric fixes read0/write1 roles under actual hardwired producer types, retaining admission/bounds/drain and default generic arbitration; every-cycle original comparison is separate. Two exact SGM control derivations remove the pool overflow cone from upstream ready and redundant sticky-fault stop decode; overflow detection/write suppression and drain remain. Eight local pool frames plus forced-overflow quarantine pass, while completeSGM equivalence is a separate gate; prior reads add2cycles with unchanged addresses/traffic. Stream ABI compares269460 outputs/18 interleavings and18A9units compile. Component/platform permission only; complete numerical/ELF/physical/board gates remain separate.
limitations: Original legacy neural run used a functional cycle-reference DSP model; no new full neural vendorDSP equivalence is inferred.
Fresh wrapper ADD/BOX checks do not exercise fullNN or fullSGM; oldSGM and oldNN frames are distinct evidence.
New owned backend, complete same-source SGM/model and fullA9ELF remain pending; no realcache/DDR/dualcore/performance claim.
